card.title: Designated Reality Check
card.instruction: Return automatically to translating every bizarre development into practical consequences, even when everyone else seems comfortable with it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The fountain's producing wishes. Who empties the bucket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Miracles still overflow onto borrowed carpets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can wish the water away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put someone on hourly wishing duty.

mechanism: A treats wish-producing water as a cleanup obligation and converts an offered wish solution into recurring maintenance.
confusable: Unlike general practical grounding, the translation into mundane consequences must recur even after B treats the miracle as a benefit.
comparison: The fountain alternative schedules the miracle itself as a job; the floating-relatives alternative tracks physical positions for meal service.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
